questions.text: Find the area of the quadrilateral ABCD, the coordinates of whose vertices are A(6,-3),B(-4,-2),C(3,1) and D(5,0)? Ans A). 21 unit2 B). 30 unit2 C). 25 unit2 D). 16 unit2 Correct Answer: A

A cylindrical disc of thickness 1 cm is made by melting two solid cylinders of radii 4 cm and 5 cm, and length 6 cm and 4 cm, respectively. The radius of the new cylinder is: Ans A). 7 cm B). 21 cm C). 14 cm D). 28 cm Correct Answer: C
Two successive increases of 15% each, is by what percentage more than the two successive decreases of 12% each? (Rounded off to 2 decimal places) Ans B). C). D). A). Correct Answer: B

The average weight of a certain number of students in a group was 72 kg. If 11 students, with an average weight of 76 kg each, leave the group, and 5 students, each with an average weight of 79 kg, join the group, the average weight of the students in the group decreases by 0.6 kg. The number of students initially in the group was: Ans A). 21 B). 25 C). 17 D). 19 Correct Answer: A
What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹240 in 4 years at 12% per year rate of interest? Ans A). 250 B). 1000 C). 500 D). 750 Correct Answer: C
Two mixers and one TV cost ₹7,000, while two TVs and one mixer cost ₹9,800. The value of one TV is: Ans A). B). C). D). Correct Answer: D
. ₹780 crores B). ₹800 crores C). ₹760 crores D). ₹820 crores Correct Answer: A
Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 7% per year rate of interest for 5 years. Ans A). 815 B). 875 C). 915 D). 835 Correct Answer: B
The least number of square tiles required to pave the ceiling of a room 525 centimetre long and 378 centimetre broad is: Ans A). 178 B). 150 C). 380 D). 450 Correct Answer: D

By selling an article for ₹20, a dealer makes a profit of 10%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹, rounded off to two decimal place) so as to make a profit of 20%? Ans A). 2.82 B). 4.82 C). 1.82 D). 3.82 Correct Answer: C

A grocer mixes two varieties of tea worth ₹120/kg and ₹125/kg in a ratio to produce a new variety worth ₹122/kg. What is the ratio of the varieties to be mixed to obtain the new variety? Ans A). B). C). D). Correct Answer: D

A retailer allows a trade discount of 25% and a further discount of 8% on the marked price of the products, if paid along with his shop’s membership card. He makes a net profit of 15% on the cost. By what percentage are the products marked up by him? Ans A). B). C). D). Correct Answer: A

Ravi goes to college from his village at the speed of 5km/h and returns at the speed of 4km/h. If he takes 9 hours in all, find the distance (in km) between the village and the college. Ans A). 20 B). 40 C). 18 D). 9 Correct Answer: A

Two trains running towards each other on parallel tracks, at speeds of 45 km/hr and 51 km/hr, take 21 seconds to cross each other. If the length of one train is 290 m, then the length (in m) of the other train is: Ans A). 250 B). 290 C). 230 D). 270 Correct Answer: D

The ratio of the present ages of Ram and Shyam is 3 : 4, and 4 years ago the ratio was 2 : 3. What will be the ratio of the ages of Ram and Shyam 4 years from now? Ans A). 4 : 5 B). 1 : 5 C). 2 : 5 D). 3 : 5 Correct Answer: A

A borrows ₹89,500 for 3 years at 7% p.a. simple interest. B borrows the same amount at simple interest of 9% for the first year, 8% for the second year, and 7% for the third year. What is the total simple interest (in ₹) paid by A and B? Ans A). 45,027 B). 47,025 C). 42,075 D). 40,275 Correct Answer: D
The average of 9 numbers is 3. If the average of the first 8 of these numbers is 2, the 9th number is: Ans A). 11 B). 12 C). 14 D). 15 Correct Answer: A
A cylindrical tank of height 10 m and radius 5 m has a small circular cut of 0.5 m radius on its top surface. What would be the total surface area of the tank? Ans B). D). Correct Answer: A A). C).

The given bar graph shows the production of onions (in quintals) from the year 2018 to 2022. Study the graph and answer the question that follows. Considering the average production during this period, the number of years in which the production is above the average is: Ans A). 2 B). 3 C). 1 D). 4 Correct Answer: A
Find the average of 300, 129, 49, 120 and 102. Ans A). 130 B). 120 C). 150 D). 140 Correct Answer: D
